title: Locker and Tryouts
author: Lena Almeida
blurb: Odile Vasquez, a scholarship student at an academy with too many secrets, counts days until graduation like a sentence being served. Then the school's legendary ghost starts leaving notes addressed by name — in impossible ink — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must decide who to be when the labels come off before the final audition.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
